AuthorizePayment. One authorization per checkout session (ErrDuplicateAuthorization; a replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the existing one; so does a new key while the session holds a live authorization, answered 200 instead of 201). checkout calls this with key &lt;sessionId&gt;:auth and one allocation per shipment group (1 to 50, distinct groupNo); allocations must sum to the authorized total (ErrAllocationMismatch). On a provider decline the record is DECLINED (terminal, 201 with declineReason) and the checkout session stays open for another token.
